title: 第21章 仇人见面必定互怼第22章 继续互怼进入秘境
slug: 开局签到帝经我家族独断万古
lines: 看着这场汹涌的“爱的教育”。
对此早已习以为常的林家众人，没有丝毫意外，也没有丝毫要阻止的意思。
反而是在一旁津津乐道的吃着瓜，不时还要调侃一两句。
“啧，又开始了，你们说这浩然这小子咋就不长记性呢？”
“谁说不是呢，这不，又挨二爷揍了。”
“不过你们别说，每次看二爷揍浩然这小子揍得这么爽，就感觉手痒痒……”
“好想回家把那个逆子也揍一顿。”
“我也是……不行，此次任务回去，必须把我家那逆子也揍一顿才行。”
“这样，要不回去后我们举办一场“教育逆子大赛”吧，每人出一件宝物，谁赢到最后，谁就可以获得所有的宝物，怎样？”
“这个主意好，我参加了。”
“俺也一样！”
“加我一个！”
“逆子”们：so？我们也是你们play中的一环？
“愚蠢的弟弟啊，咋就想不起来二叔也在场呢。”
看着一边撕心裂肺的哀嚎的林浩然，林轩眼神玩味，有点幸灾乐祸的暗道。
这时林浩然惨叫一声后，不由得将求救的目光投向一旁的好大哥林轩，那眼神仿佛在说“轩哥救我啊！”
对此，林轩摊了摊手表示无能为力。
“不是哥不想帮你，哥也没办法啊。”
“再说你被揍了这么多次，也不差这一顿。”
林轩用只有两兄弟才懂的眼神传递信息。
毫不犹豫的被自己的“好大哥”拒绝，林浩然当场傻眼。
直到那“至尊皮带”带来的极致舒爽再次袭来，才让他立马回神。
“怒视”着林轩，仿佛在说“好你个林狗，不讲义气！那10万贡献点别想我还了！”
林轩毫不在意，继续津津乐道的吃着瓜。
啧，看着真爽……
content_en:
Look at this turbulent "education of love".
Everyone in the Lin family, who had long been accustomed to this, was not surprised at all, and had no intention of stopping it.
Instead, he ate the melon with relish and made fun of her from time to time.
"Tsk, it's starting again. Why doesn't this kid Haoran have a long memory?"
"Who says it's not the case? No, I got beaten by the second master again."
"But don't tell me, every time I see the second master beating Haoran so well, my hands feel itchy..."
"I really want to go home and beat up that traitor too."
"Me too... No, I have to beat up my treacherous son when I return from this mission."
"+1!"
"+1!"
…
"Well, how about we hold an "Education Contest" after we go back. Each person will give out a treasure, and whoever wins in the end can get all the treasures. How about that?"
"This is a good idea, I'm participating."
"Me too!"
"Add me one!"
+1
+1
…
"Rebellious sons": so? Are we also part of your play?
…
"Stupid brother, why can't you remember that your second uncle is also here?"
Looking at Lin Haoran who was wailing heart-wrenchingly, Lin Xuan's eyes were filled with amusement, a little gloating secretly.
"Ah!"
At this time, after Lin Haoran screamed, he couldn't help but cast his eyes for help to his good brother Lin Xuan on the side. His eyes seemed to say, "Brother Xuan, help me!"
In response, Lin Xuan spread his hands and expressed his helplessness.
"It's not that I don't want to help you, there's nothing I can do about it."
"Besides, you've been beaten so many times, so this one is not enough."
Lin Xuan conveyed the message with eyes that only two brothers could understand.
Being rejected by his "good big brother" without hesitation, Lin Haoran was dumbfounded on the spot.
It wasn't until the ultimate comfort brought by the "Supreme Belt" hit him again that he immediately came back to his senses.
"glaring" at Lin Xuan, as if to say, "You are a Lin dog, you have no sense of loyalty! Don't expect me to pay back those 100,000 contribution points!"
Lin Xuan didn't care and continued to eat the melon with relish.
Gee, it looks so cool...
title_en: Chapter 21: Enemies will always fight each other when they meet. Chapter 22: Continue fighting each other and enter the secret realm.
